operational_definition: Household disposable income or consumption deflated using suitable local price index and equivalence method documented before study
data_source: Approved household survey or official administrative source
limitations: Household composition informal earnings missingness comparability

operational_definition: Prespecified validated local question about inability to meet essential expenses in a defined recall period
Distance between household resources and the appropriately specified local poverty threshold
limitations: Country threshold and PPP revisions prevent naive comparison

operational_definition: Number confirmed receiving the specified eligible benefit during the prespecified interval
data_source: Authorised benefits records or consented verifiable confirmation
limitations: Eligibility errors delayed payments attrition and data access

indicator_name: Time and cost of benefit navigation
operational_definition: Time and out-of-pocket expense needed to access or seek the benefit under a prespecified protocol
limitations: Recall burden and variation in application channels

operational_definition: Verified household energy expense divided by appropriately measured household resources in comparable periods
denominator_or_population: Households with comparable bills and resources
data_source: Legally authorised billing records with suitable household resources and ethical participation consent where applicable
limitations: Weather tariff season household size and tenure confound interpretation

operational_definition: Prespecified validated measure of inability to afford necessary heating or other essential energy use
limitations: Recall and contextual differences; comfort needs vary

operational_definition: Self-reported or independently defined episode of needed care forgone due to affordability or access barrier
limitations: Requires stronger ethics and legal basis; demand and health status confound rates

operational_definition: Continuing attendance or progression in an applicable learning programme with verified definition
data_source: Appropriate approved institution records or survey
limitations: Not relevant in every study and should not be collected by default

operational_definition: Net earned resources over specified recent period adjusted to local price index and observed at sustained follow-up
data_source: Approved records or calibrated consented earnings survey
limitations: Seasonality informality selection and displacement risks

operational_definition: Prespecified locally validated job-security rights safety and scheduling measure
limitations: Cultural comparability and employer retaliation risk

operational_definition: Change in employment and earnings among relevant nonparticipant workers in defined market
data_source: Approved labour market statistics or ethically collected data
limitations: Causal attribution market boundaries and power challenges

operational_definition: Score from a culturally adapted validated autonomy instrument without coercive interviewing
limitations: Measurement invariance social desirability and reporting burden

operational_definition: Primary outcome effect estimates reported by prespecified relevant groups where lawful feasible and powered
limitations: Multiple testing privacy small cells and low subgroup precision

operational_definition: Programme delivery and participant time costs reported separately from estimated incremental benefit; optional cost per incremental outcome only when interpretable
denominator_or_population: All relevant implementing units and participants
data_source: Audited programme accounts plus consented time data
limitations: Ratio unstable or undefined if incremental effect is zero negative or uncertain; report raw incremental costs and effects
